description.describe_ch: This course is designed to develop public speaking skills . Public speaking is a vital soft skill - be it used in the classroom or for a presentation at work . Attention will also be given to individual communication activities designed to improve the ability to organize , reason tically , and to listen effectively . Each student will develop and deliver several speeches and participate in peer evaluations.
description.describe_eh: This course is designed to develop public speaking skills . Public speaking is a vital soft skill - be it used in the classroom or for a presentation at work . Attention will also be given to individual communication activities designed to improve the ability to organize , reason tically , and to listen effectively . Each student will develop and deliver several speeches and participate in peer evaluations.

Selecting Topic and Purpose, Audience Analysis

Focus on IELTS Part 2

Group presentation #1, peer analysis and teacher feedback
Choose a persuasive speech topic.
Focus on IELTS Part 3

Topic analysis by purpose
Prepare vocabulary for hometown and study questions: IELTS Part 1

Organizing Main Points, Introductions and Conclusions
IELTS Part 1 and 3

Informative Speaking, Outlining Review, Fact-checking, Citing Sources

Informative Speech (with visual aids), Peer Analysis

Persuasive topic-pitch a new product/service

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Expectations
The following guidelines will create a comfortable and productive learning environment throughout the semester.

You can expect me:
•	To start and end class on time.
•	To reply to e-mails within 24 hours on weekdays and 48 hours on weekends.
•	To assign homework that adequately covers the material and meets the learning objectives of the course while adhering to the time expectations.
•	To give exams that accurately reflect the material covered in class and assigned in homework.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
I can expect you:

•	To come to class on time.
•	To be attentive and engaged in class.
•	To refrain from using laptops, cell phones and other electronic devices during class.
•	To spend an adequate amount of time on the homework each week, making an effort to solve and understand each problem.
•	To seek help when appropriate. I am here to help as well as instruct.
